title: Bethany House Serves Thanksgiving Meal to Nearly 350, Continuing a 40-Year Tradition
excerpt: Bethany House served a Thanksgiving meal in downtown Laredo on Thursday, November 26, feeding close to 350 people and continuing a tradition of more than 40 years.
content:
Bethany House served a Thanksgiving meal in downtown Laredo on Thursday, November 26, continuing a tradition that has brought people together for more than 40 years, according to KGNS.

People lined up inside the building for the holiday meal of turkey, green beans and mashed potatoes, with stuffing, cranberry sauce and dinner rolls also on the plates, KGNS reported.

Despite the cold weather, volunteers served close to 350 people on Thanksgiving Day, according to the KGNS report by Michelle James Thorpe.

Bethany House has served Laredo's downtown community for decades, and the Thanksgiving meal remains one of its longest-running traditions.

Sources: KGNS; Laredo News (KGNS): Laredo's Bethany House continues Thanksgiving meal tradition, Nov. 26, 2026.
